offering_description.value: Brink’s transports, counts and processes cash for banks, retailers and other businesses. It manages ATMs and helps retailers deposit and reconcile cash using smart safes and digital tools. It also ships and stores valuables through its armored fleet, vaults and international logistics network.

primary_services.value: Armored cash transport; cash processing and vaulting; ATM management; retail cash management; secure valuables logistics and storage

customer_segment.value: B2B: Banks, credit unions, retailers, ATM operators, jewelers and precious metals businesses; B2G: Central banks and government mints

end_markets.value: Banking; retail; ATM networks; jewelry and diamonds; precious metals

revenue_model.value: service fees: Cash pickup, processing, vaulting and secure shipments; project or contract: Outsourced ATM operations and retail cash management programs

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Collects and processes cash for banks and retailers and ships valuables for businesses and public institutions; asset operator: Runs armored fleets, cash centers and vaults that handle banknotes, coins and valuables for customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Cash transport and processing, ATM operations, retail cash management and valuables logistics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Account teams serving banks, retailers and other institutional customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Armored-car carrier and armed-guard licensing in jurisdictions such as New York, plus customs rules for cross-border shipments
